programme.title: L'ultime sacrifice
programme.desc: Basé sur une histoire vraie, l'aviateur William H. Pitsenbarger reçoit la plus haute distinction militaire.

programme.title: Sexy Therapy
programme.desc: L'histoire de Nathan Fisher, la trentaine, écrivain vivant à Brooklyn et dont la carrière est au point mort. Sa petite amie vient de le quitter et il apprend que son père est hospitalisé. Il décide alors de retourner en Floride pour s'occuper de sa famille.

programme.title: Le Mytho
programme.desc: Danny est un brillant chirurgien esthétique qui a toujours prétendu être marié pour éviter toute forme d'engagement. Lorsqu'il trouve finalement la femme de ses rêves, il ne joue pas de ce stratagème mais l'alliance qui lui servait d'alibi est découverte.

programme.title: Témoin à Louer
programme.desc: Doug Harris a un vrai problème: le jeune homme, qui n'a pas une vie sociale très riche, est sur le point de se marier, mais n'a pas de témoin.

programme.title: Amour Aveugle
programme.desc: Un romancier new-yorkais est rendu aveugle par un accident de voiture qui tue sa femme. Des années plus tard, il retrouve l'envie de vivre et d'écrire lorsqu'il commence une aventure avec une femme négligée par son mari, un homme d'affaires.

programme.title: La dernière chance
programme.desc: Un agent du FBI doit négocier avec une femme qui prend un hôpital en otage afin de mettre la main sur un médicament expérimental.

programme.title: La mémoire de mon pays
programme.desc: Langston Whitfield est journaliste au Washington Post. Son rédacteur en chef l'envoie en Afrique du Sud pour couvrir les audiences de la Commission Vérité et Réconciliation, où les auteurs de meurtres et de tortures des deux camps durant l'Apartheid sont invités à se présenter et à affronter leurs victimes. En disant la vérité sans fard et en exprimant des remords, ils peuvent obtenir l'amnistie. Les profondes blessures de l'Apartheid peuvent-elles être guéries par la réconciliation ?

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam et Tusker voyagent à travers l'Angleterre dans leur vieux camping-car pour voir leurs amis, leur famille et des lieux du passé. Depuis le diagnostic de démence de Tusker, leur temps ensemble le plus précieux de tous.

programme.title: The Mysteries of Pittsburgh
programme.desc: Pittsburgh, Erwachsenwerden in den 1980er Jahren. Anfang Juni nennt Art Beckstein dies den letzten Sommer seines Lebens – danach wird er als Börsenmakler arbeiten. Arts Vater ist der Mafiaboss der Stadt, lenkt Arts Leben und beurteilt seine Entscheidungen. Auf einer Party sieht Art Jane, klug, blond, lieblich. Sie treffen sich sie hat einen Freund. Am nächsten Tag holt Cleveland, der Freund, Art von der Arbeit ab und der Sommer voller Abenteuer beginnt. Cleveland lebt am Rande des Abgrunds er ist explosiv, mit Anzeichen von Problemen mit lokalen Schlägern. Das Freundschaftsdreieck wird kompliziert, als Cleveland für ein paar Wochen verschwindet. Kann Art seine Gefühle ordnen und Cleveland helfen? Welche Rolle spielt sein Vater dabei?

programme.title: Bienvenue à Acapulco
programme.desc: Un développeur doit se rendre au Nouveau-Mexique mais se trompe d'avion et se retrouve au Mexique.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Le Voyage Fantastique: Des Freres Bodganov
programme.desc: Une série innovante qui éclaire des sujets captivants.

programme.title: Elle: La Cendrillon des temps modernes
programme.desc: Elle rencontre son prince et prouve aux divas que le « heureux pour toujours » n'est qu'une chanson.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: 5 Weddings
programme.desc: Une journaliste tombe amoureuse d'un homme parmi des danseurs trans et des chocs culturels.

programme.title: Hitch Expert En Séduction
programme.desc: A New York, Hitch exerce une activité aussi originale que secrète : il aide les plus timides à conquérir la femme de leur vie. Son dernier client, Albert, un comptable, est tombé éperdument amoureux de la célèbre Allegra Cole. En guidant Albert vers le bonheur, Hitch rencontre Sara Melas, une journaliste people qui suit Allegra comme une ombre. Pour Hitch, c'est le coup de foudre, mais les conseils qu'il donne aux autres ne lui suffiront pas forcément, d'autant que la journaliste rêve de démasquer le mystérieux conseiller en séduction dont toute la ville parle…

programme.title: Step Brothers
programme.desc: Deux garçons gâtés l'un par sa mère, l'autre par son père, deviennent demi-frères quand leurs parents tombent amoureux et se marient.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: Dans la petite ville touristique de Nelson, Washington, le sympathique chef des pompiers , C.D. Bales (Steve Martin) est sensible aux remarques sur son nez particulièrement long. Une belle astronome intelligente, Roxanne (Daryl Hannah), en ville pour étudier une comète, est attirée par un autre nouveau-venu, le pompier professionnel travaillant auprès de C.D., Chris (Rick Rossovich).

programme.title: L'an 1 : Des Debuts Difficiles
programme.desc: Deux "chasseurs-cueilleurs" feignants sont bannis de leur village natal. Ils se lancent alors dans une odyssée à travers un monde primitif.

programme.title: Le Temoin Amoureux
programme.desc: Tom et Claire sont amis depuis une dizaine d'années. Lorsque cette dernière lui demande d'être son garçon d'honneur, il s'aperçoit qu'il est en fait amoureux d'elle. Il accepte cependant sa proposition avec l'espoir secret de pouvoir la conquérir.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: Afin de protéger une belle femme et son fils d'un braqueur, l'agent du FBI Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) est chargé d'une opération secrète consistant à se déguiser en femme âgée obèse afin d'enquêter sur un crime antérieur.

programme.title: The People We Hate at the Wedding
programme.desc: Dans cette comédie hilarante, Alice, Paul et leur mère très optimiste sont invités au mariage de leur demi-sœur, l'occasion pour eux de se retrouver.

programme.title: Amsterdam
programme.desc: Une épopée criminelle inédite retraçant un sinistre complot de l'histoire américaine.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes & John Watson
programme.desc: Les frangins malgré eux se retrouvent. Cette fois, ils interprètent le plus grand détective du monde et son fidèle acolyte et biographe. Will Ferrell et John C. Reilly jouent Holmes et Watson. Ensemble, ils élucident un meurtre à Buckingham Palace.

programme.title: Clayton l'implacable
programme.desc: La sœur de Clayton est violée et assassinée. L'heure de la vengeance mortelle a sonné !

programme.title: Django défie Sartana
programme.desc: Le frère du tueur de primes Django, Steve, est lynché après avoir été accusé d'un vol de banque.

programme.title: Le colt du révérend
programme.desc: Le pasteur Miller arrive à Tucson, mais le jour même de son arrivée, une bande de malfaiteurs braque la banque, et les habitants l'accusent d'être l'auteur du braquage.

programme.title: Shanghaï Joe
programme.desc: Un immigrant chinois, récemment arrivé en Amérique, se bat pour libérer des esclaves mexicains de leur cruel maître.

programme.title: Creuse ta fosse, j'aurai ta peau
programme.desc: Un homme est faussement accusé de vol de banque, ce qui pousse son frère à le faire sortir de prison.

programme.title: Winnetou III : SUR LA PISTE DES DESPERADOS
programme.desc: La bande de Rollins veut s'emparer des terres en incitant les colons à faire la guerre aux Indiens, mais Winnetou et Old Shatterhand tentent de maintenir la paix, jusqu'à ce que Rollins fasse accuser Winnetou du meurtre du fils du chef Jicarilla.

programme.title: Durango encaisse ou tue
programme.desc: Un agent de recouvrement se retrouve dans une situation dangereuse lorsque l'homme d'affaires corrompu pour lequel il a récupéré 100 000 dollars ne veut pas lui verser le pourcentage habituel pour ses services.

programme.title: Les Femmes de Jesse James
programme.desc: Jesse James est tellement occupé à courir les jupons que sa carrière de hors-la-loi commence à en pâtir.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: Un capitaine de cavalerie a beaucoup de mal à maintenir la paix entre son colonel tyrannique et un chef indien déterminé à se venger.

programme.title: The Blazing World
programme.desc: Des décennies après la noyade accidentelle de sa soeur jumelle, une jeune femme autodestructrice retourne dans sa maison familiale, se retrouvant attirée par une autre dimension où sa soeur est peut-être encore en vie.

programme.title: Je suis vivant!
programme.desc: Un journaliste américain placé temporairement en Europe centrale recherche sa nouvelle petite amie, qui a soudainement disparu.

programme.title: Une femme sous emprise
programme.desc: Des événements mystérieux et effrayants arrivent à Alexandra, et le temps qu'elle réalise que son ex-mari violent n'est pas à blâmer, elle se retrouve fermement entre les griffes d'une force meurtrière qui ne reculera devant rien, même devant la tombe, pour l'avoir.

programme.title: Metamorphosis
programme.desc: Trois jeunes voyagent à travers la campagne hongroise dans l'espoir d'étayer la thèse au sujet de la légendaire Comtesse Elizabeth Bathory, réputée pour s'être baignée dans le sang au XVIIème siècle. Mais ils se perdent sur le retour, jusqu'à ce qu'une étrange jeune femme leur propose de les conduire au château Bathory.

programme.title: Narcopolis
programme.desc: Londres, 2024. Les drogues, devenues légales à la fabrication et à la consommation, sont contrôlées et exploitées par des sociétés pharmaceutiques. Mais un marché noir de substances bien plus dangereuses encore existe.

programme.title: Mort En Direct
programme.desc: Le soldat Wyatt Maddox se rend à la maison à l'enterrement de son petit frère pour constater que sa mort n'était pas aussi simple que la police le voudrait. Avec l'aide de Tara, le partenaire en ligne de son frère, il se met à résoudre le mystère sans savoir a quel point l'entreprise est insidieuse

programme.title: Les dieux des profondeurs
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une mission audacieuse conduit une équipe de sous-marin en eaux profondes dans une mystérieuse ouverture au fond de l'océan, ils découvrent un monde sous-marin perdu et réveillent son ancienne race d'êtres d'un autre monde...

programme.title: Orcs Wars
programme.desc: Une armée d'Orcs est envoyée dans notre monde pour l'envahir. Un ancien militaire est désigné malgré lui comme étant LE tueur d'Orcs et l'unique sauveur de l'humanité. L'affrontement ultime peut commencer.

programme.title: Sentinelle
programme.desc: Sur une base militaire isolée au bord d'un vaste océan, deux soldats attendent la fin de leur service de deux ans. Lorsqu'il y a un retard et que le navire tant attendu arrive vide, la tension entre eux commence à monter, et la situation devient incontrôlable.

programme.desc: Une nounou séduisante trouble Egor, qui doute bientôt de sa véritable identité.

programme.desc: En 1942 à Prague, un officier SS est victime d'un attentat organisé par la Résistance.

programme.desc: L'histoire vraie de la vie d'un vétéran afro-américain âgé atteint de trouble bipolaire.

programme.title: The Old Way
programme.desc: Colton Briggs, un ancien bandit armé, tient désormais une épicerie et vit tranquillement avec sa famille.

programme.title: Golda
programme.desc: Le 6 octobre 1973, en pleine fête du Kippour, les forces combinées de l'Égypte, de la Syrie et de la Jordanie lancent une attaque surprise sur Israël.

programme.desc: UNDERCOVER est tiré de l'émouvante histoire vraie d'un père ouvrier et de son fils adolescent, Rick Wershe Jr., qui devint informateur pour le FBI puis dealer de drogue, avant d'être abandonné par ceux qui l'avaient utilisé, et condamné à perpétuité.

programme.title: La Prophétie des ombres
programme.desc: Un reporter est dans une petite ville de Virginie pour enquêter sur une série d'événements étranges.

programme.title: Munich 72 : L'Attentat
programme.desc: JO 1972 de Munich: des terroristes palestiniens attaquent la délégation israélienne.

programme.title: The Son
programme.desc: Laura doit décider jusqu'où elle ira pour protéger son fils des forces terrifiantes de son passé.

programme.title: Marionnette
programme.desc: Une thérapeute perd le contrôle de la réalité face à un garçon affirmant pouvoir contrôler son avenir.

programme.title: A Good Man
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire essaie de mener une vie ordinaire en travaillant dans un complexe d'appartements. Mais l'un de ses locataires lui fait rapidement reprendre du service lorsqu'il se retrouve sous l'emprise d'un gangster russe…

programme.title: The Last Victim
programme.desc: Hickey, Sheriff d'une petite ville américaine, doit résoudre le pire cas de sa carrière lorsqu'un horrible crime est commis par un gang local ultra-violent.

programme.title: Two Warriors : Le Combat du Siècle
programme.desc: Tokyo, peu après la seconde Guerre Mondiale. Un champion de boxe japonais jusque là invaincu se prépare à affronter un challenger américain.

programme.title: Gun
programme.desc: La police de Detroit cible Rich (50 Cent), un trafiquant d'armes charismatique, alors que la violence par armes à feu s'intensifie. Son ancien ami Angel (Val Kilmer), travaillant secrètement avec le détective Rogers, infiltre l'opération de Rich.

programme.title: Vigilante
programme.desc: Fou de rage après l'agression de son épouse et le meurtre de son fils et écœuré par le laxisme et la corruption des autorités, qui ont permis aux responsables d'être libérés, un électricien new-yorkais s'acoquine avec un groupe d'auto-défense, dans lequel il refusait d'entrer jusqu'alors, afin de venger sa famille.

programme.title: L'Enfer des Zombies
programme.desc: Un navire venu des Antilles accoste au port de New York sans âme qui vive à bord, si ce n'est un zombie qui attaque deux gardes côtes. Avec l'aide d'un journaliste, la fille du propriétaire du bateau décide d'aller enquêter aux Antilles pour retrouver son père. Ils se rendent sur l'île de Matu et y rencontrent le docteur David Menard, qui tente d'inventer un remède contre une maladie qui ramène les morts à la vie, les changeant en zombies cannibales.

programme.title: Demon City Shinjuku
programme.desc: Dix ans après qu'un sorcier maléfique, Rebi Ra, a transformé Shinjuku en une ville démoniaque, un jeune combattant nommé Kyoya est contraint d'affronter cet ennemi redoutable. Avec l'aide de Sayaka, la fille du président du monde libre, et d'étranges alliés rencontrés en chemin, il doit traverser les ruines infestées de créatures démoniaques pour empêcher Rebi Ra d'ouvrir un portail vers les enfers et de plonger le monde entier dans le chaos.

programme.title: L'Appel de la Chair
programme.desc: Jeune actrice de comédie musicale, Laura se désespère de sa situation : elle sort d'une opération liée à son cancer, doit retourner vivre dans la maison de son enfance, et son compagnon Jacob vient de la quitter. Sa vie bascule encore davantage lorsqu'elle découvre qu'un monstre vit désormais chez elle.

programme.title: Totem
programme.desc: Buffle, un ancien scout, n'a toujours pas fait le deuil de son ami disparu il y a vingt ans. En plus de cela, il est constamment hanté par un rat géant… Sa psychologue lui conseille de reformer sa bande en organisant un camp. Mais cette thérapie de groupe va prendre une nouvelle dimension lorsque que nos quadragénaires vont découvrir un passage temporel.

programme.title: MR-9 Do or Die
programme.desc: Un espion d'élite bangladais fait équipe avec un agent de la CIA pour démanteler une organisation criminelle internationale dirigée par un homme d'affaires impitoyable.

programme.title: President Down
programme.desc: Un message secret annonce que le pacemaker de la Présidente a été compromis.

programme.title: Rogue Agent

programme.desc: Dans un monde dévasté, Jake affronte la barbarie pour sauver celle qu'il aime.

Terrel vient d'être libéré de prison et le temps qu'il a passé derrière les barreaux n'a fait qu'alimenter sa soif de vengeance, ce qui ne sera pas facile pour cet ancien détenu aigri. Lorsque Philip Sauvage forme une unité spéciale de baroudeurs et d'anciens soldats pour protéger Barclay, le voyou déterminé est forcé de se battre contre une équipe de combattants suffisamment expérimentés pour mener une petite guerre.

Cet homme strict et austère, père célibataire et policier, s'est autoproclamé responsable de la sécurité du quartier.

Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Flower magic in Madeira: The Flower Festival Festa da Flor is the most important event of the year for the people of the Atlantic island. With it they celebrate spring, which is climatically practically all year round here, their island and themselves. The coast formed by lava, centuries-old laurel forests and green steep slopes make Madeira unique. Those who start right at the front of the big parade of the flower festival in the capital Funchal, will have made it. For Isabel Borges this dream has come true. She opens this year's flower parade along the harbour promenade with her festive group. This accolade does not only mean fame and prestige, but also a lot of pressure. Are the self-designed dresses splendid enough? Will the 150 flower children learn the dance steps in time? Will the flowers on the float hold out in the heat? For Isabel, it is now a matter of nerves.

programme.title: Dream Islands of Europe: Lanzarote and Fuerteventura
programme.desc: The film presents the two Canary Islands Lanzarote and Fuerteventura. Lanzarote has a rich culture in addition to a volcanic landscape: the film accompanies a ceramic artist, an instrument maker, shows architecture by César Manrique and a camel breeder. On Fuerteventura, in addition to livestock farming and the operation of traditional grain mills, nature conservation plays a major role: islanders are committed to preserving the sand dunes, and there is a turtle hatchery. On Lanzarote, countless volcanic eruptions have formed a bizarre lunar landscape. It is a great challenge for the inhabitants to extract the cultivation of food from the karstic, dry soil. And yet they even manage to produce wine. Protected by thousands of small depressions that act as water reservoirs, they grow vines on porous volcanic rock.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: La Palma: The Greenest of the Canaries
programme.desc: Thundering waterfalls, ancient forests and an impressive volcanic landscape with black beaches: La Palma is a dream island for nature lovers. It is by far the island of the Canary Islands with the most green, almost half of it is covered with forest. But once a year the green island is dominated by the color white. On Rosenmontag (Rose Monday), the inhabitants have for decades been targeting those ancestors who returned from abroad wealthy and ostentatiously demonstrated their wealth with powdered faces. The carnivalistic approach culminates every year in a white chaos, with tons of talcum, flour or paint trickling down the uniformly white dressed islanders. On the Roque de los Muchachos, La Palma's highest mountain at 2,400 meters, stands one of the largest reflecting telescopes in the world. Astrophysicists love the island because it is the perfect place to look into space. Researchers and star lovers look spellbound to Beteigeuze. The giant star is probably in front of a supernova and could become a second moon in the firmament.

programme.title: Fuerteventura: The golden beauty of the Canaries
programme.desc: Fuerteventura, the second largest of the Canary Islands, is located just 120 kilometres off the coast of West Africa. The climate is extremely dry and the struggle for water has always been a major setback. Then, around a century ago, returning US emigrants brought what were then modern wind turbine water pumps from the Aermotor Windmill Company with them to Fuerte-ventura. Today, the environmentally friendly and so-called “Chicago's”, experience a renaissance. Unfortu-nately, original spare parts in good condition are diffi-cult to come by. When Leocadio Araya Sanchez began planting countless cacti on a barren hillside a few years ago, people thought he was mad. His idea was to make a healthy juice drink from the prickly pears – with great success. But getting the fruit to release its pre-cious superfood juice is no simple task. On an almost daily basis, Marcos Tapia is magnetically attracted to one of the paradisiacal beaches of the island. The 44-year-old is Spanish champion and vice world champion in para-body board surfing. When he was 28. Marcos was involved in a serious motorbike accident and has been paraplegic ever since.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America's National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: Rivers and Lakes
programme.desc: Water is the beginning of all life - including the wildlife of Germany. Beavers fell trees, otters play under water, kingfishers catch fish for their young. Lakes and rivers cover just 2.5% of the total area of the country. The episode Rivers and Lakes takes the viewer on a journey through the water world of Germany. In winter, the few ice-free surfaces are popular with waterfowl. Coots throng the source ponds of the River Havel, while above them white-tailed eagles gather for the hunt, as their prey swim openly beneath them. The coots stick together, swimming to and fro to make it difficult for the eagles to pick out one individual bird. But with each attack, the coots grow increasingly tired. In Spring, the ice melts and the lakes and rivers awake from their winter torpor. Germany has more than 800 rivers longer than 10km. They transport the life-giving liquid into all corners of the country. The water of the River Danube alone would be enough to fill Germany's biggest body of water, Lake Constance, in 12 months. Every year, six times the volume of the lake falls in the form of precipitation: 800 litres per square metre. Otters and beavers had a very hard time in recent centuries. They were hunted mercilessly for their fur and eaten in periods of fasting. Today, both species are protected and their populations are recovering.

programme.title: Departures S02 E01
programme.desc: Justin has been travelling alone for the past couple of months when Scott and Andre decide to come meet him at a festival in Spain. They head to Gibraltar, where Justin is attacked by candy-stealing Apes, before hopping on a ferry and completely switching continents. Now in Morocco, they head inland towards Fès, then further into the snow-covered Atlas Mountains to stay in a traditional Moroccan kasbah. They end their trip with a long climb up Jbel Toubkal – the highest mountain in North Africa. Three strong again, they find reason to keep travelling together.

programme.title: Departures S02 E02
programme.desc: After many visa difficulties, Scott and Justin are finally allowed to enter Libya. They travel from Tripoli to Jebel Nafusa, before getting lost in the abandoned city of Ghadames. They wander around the maze of empty streets and homes before finding each other again, and drive deep into the Sahara desert to climb some of the world's largest sand dunes, and sand-board in their own private oasis.

programme.title: Departures S02 E03
programme.desc: The guys reunite with Gisele, whom they had met on their previous trip to Jordan. A native to Brazil, Gisele shows them around Rio de Janeiro. She takes them hang gliding, to a football match, and into the ghettos before they hit the road for the Pantanal. Here they find poisonous plants, the worlds largest living rodents, and catch piranha for lunch - none of the reasons why Justin ends up in the hospital. This is a great opportunity for the guys to learn about Brazil's dangers before reaching the Amazon.

programme.title: Departures S02 E04
programme.desc: There are so many things that can kill you in the Amazon. The guys rent a boat as protection and head down river to explore the rainforest. They find poisonous insects, angry snakes, and natives living in hand-built huts. After getting stuck in a 70 meter high tree in an Amazonian thunderstorm, and attacked by vicious pink dolphins, they hop on a plane headed for the island of Fernando de Noronha. Here they try their hand at scuba diving and witness the hatching of close to 1000 baby sea turtles. The dynamic changes when Justin and Gisele know their time together will soon be ending.

programme.title: Departures S02 E05
programme.desc: Avoiding the resorts and the all-inclusive vacation, Scott and Justin rent a car and head towards the tobacco fields around Viñales. They're looking for a specific farmer to return a picture to him from a friend who visited years ago. After the successful search and a visit into the farmer's home, they grab a couple of horses to ride into the countryside and try some sugarcane rum. On their way to Trinidad they pick up a hitchhiker, play a game of baseball with some kids, and are invited to take part in a traditional Santeria ceremony. But even the swinging machete, beating drums, sacrificed chicken, rum and cigars won't end this trip. The three drive along the south east coast and visit Fidel Castro's remote hideout on their way to Carnival in Santiago de Cuba.

programme.title: Departures S02 E06
programme.desc: After being separated at the airport and put on different flights, Scott arrives to find that his bag has gone missing. The guys grab supplies and climb into an old soviet van to start a long trek out to a Nomadic Reindeer tribe. But to get there, they will have to travel by van then by horseback for four days. Scott and Justin take part in the tribe's traditional way of life and come to understand the necessity of the nature and balance around them.

programme.title: Alan Cummings Paradise Homes S01 E03 Highland Hideaways and Caves
programme.desc: On a journey back to his rugged roots of the Scottish Highlands, Alan experiences an extraordinary hidden getaway living in harmony with ancient land, complete with 360 views and golden eagles circling the property. In Sicily, Alan tours an eccentric family home built above a cave, filled with innovative and intricate space-saving details, including a one-of-a-kind bedroom climbing wall!

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: Majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, raging waterfalls, threatening fjords, mighty glaciers, endless lava fields – there is hardly another country in the world that offers as much impressive nature as Iceland, the remote island in the harsh North Sea. The nature in Iceland is immense! Here, the four elements of nature can be experienced as raw and as close-up as practically no other place on Earth. And nowhere on the northern hemisphere can the origin of life, can growth and decay be experienced as dramatically as here. Besides the impressive nature, we get to know the dramatic history of the Viking culture with its nature-influenced mythology and discuss the negative effects of excessive tourism.

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: This documentary is a scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.title: RELEASE ME
programme.desc: Release Me chronicles the story of Texas killer Kenneth Allen McDuff who received the death sentence in 1966 for a murderous rampage that left three teen-agers dead. He was paroled years later only to kill again. His subsequent recapture and trial resulted in another death sentence, carried out in 1998. After a public outcry over his parole, there was a complete overhaul of the prison and parole systems in Texas. All told, the killer was positively linked to six murders, but it is believed that he was responsible for as many as 13 during his lifetime. Viewers gain an inside looks at the teams of prosecutors who brought him to justice and who put him on death row, not once, but twice.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.desc: Koh Ae-rin, a mom that quit her job a long time ago, starts looking for a job to make a living when her husband suddenly passes away. While doing something no one asked her to at her new job, she finds out a secret of the Korean office of Cornerstone, an international military industrial complex. She gets involved with Kim Bon, the man next door that has been chasing after a huge conspiracy and involuntarily becomes a member of Kingsbag, a special organization within the National Intelligence Service(NIS). programme.title: Lost Recipes
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: Safarnama
programme.desc: Safarnama is more than just a mere journey one wants to complete just to check out that one task from the ‘ToDo List”. It is something just one of its kind. In Safarnama, we are up for a soulfulfilling journey with Ankit Siwach that is to begin in Mumbai and cease at Ladakh. This journey is to witness numerous unseen moments and unfelt experiences via a thrilling, adventurous route. It isn't just about navigating roads using GPS but more of digging deeper into the beauty of India to understand life better.

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Way Back Home
programme.desc: Rohan Thakur finds his true calling as he begins a journey to revisit his roots in Himachal Pradesh. Way Back Home is as much a travelogue of childhood, as of growing up. Get ready for a journey of a lifetime

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.desc: A journey to experience the most revered religious sites of India. A spiritual – travel series which unfolds untold stories and takes its viewers on a devotional journey."

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: Wellbeing behind the wheel – The new Bentley Azure Range
programme.desc: To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. Unique First Edition contrast stitching and embroidery adorns the seats and, depending on the choice of veneers, handcrafted metal overlays just 0.075 mm thick can be applied to the fascia and waistrails in the front and the rear door veneer. The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: GREENWASHING THE CLIMATE KILLER

Centinaia di cadaveri formano una massa informe nelle strade che si estende fino all'orizzonte, rivelando una capitale incendiata. Soli e feriti, nutriti da un odio reciproco, poliziotti e malviventi non hanno altra scelta che unire le forze e tentare di sopravvivere.
